title: A1 Intensive
description: A comprehensive A1 course covering all four skills: reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Aligned with Goethe-Institut A1 exam standards. Ideal for students targeting the A1 Zertifikat Deutsch certificate.

title: A2 Intensive
description: Build upon your A1 foundation and expand your communicative competence. A2 is required for most student visa applications to Germany. The course includes intensive grammar, listening comprehension, and oral practice.

title: B1 Intensive
description: The B1 level is the gateway to studying and working in Germany. This intensive course prepares you for the Goethe and telc B1 exam with structured grammar lessons, essay writing, and oral presentation practice.
highlights: One Session for B1 Exam Preparation
